lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. Specifically, three primary rows of high-intensity maxima are aligned along the mid-flank, with a dense cluster of approximately 12-15 blobs forming a distinct triangular sub-grouping centrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible grid pattern. These intersections are most prominent in the region between the fifth gill slit and the anterior margin of the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal aspect and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral aspect, running parallel from the cephalic region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs. These are distributed more densely toward the trailing edge and base of the fin, with a notable absence of large spots near the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology is observed between the cephalic region, where spots are small and densely clustered (high spatial frequency), and the lateral flank, where spots are significantly larger and more widely spaced (low spatial frequency).
